description.p: This is a community package of PKHeX-Avalonia, maintained independently and unaffiliated with its developer. It repackages the official upstream Linux release unmodified and follows upstream releases automatically.
PKHeX-Avalonia is a cross-platform Pokémon save file editor built with Avalonia and the upstream PKHeX core.

ul.li: Inspect and edit Pokémon, boxes and party slots.
Check legality with the PKHeX core.
Game-specific trainer, inventory and save editors.

description.p: Back up your original save before editing.

Permissions: this package grants the display, the GPU and network access (the update notice). It grants no access to your files; save files are opened and written through the file chooser, and settings stay inside the sandbox. Updates arrive through this Flatpak remote; the app's built-in self-updater stays off.
